221: In which country was the oldest surviving book printed with movable metal type produced, in 1377?
This book, the Jikji, is kept at the National Library of France.
222: Which Chinese scholar invented a device to detect earthquakes around the year 132?
A ball dropped from a dragon's mouth into a toad's mouth to show the direction of the earthquake.
223: Which German engineer built the Z3, one of the first programmable computers, in 1941?
The Z3 ran on more than 2000 electrical relays.
224: Which 19th-century Englishwoman is considered the first computer programmer in history?
She was the daughter of the English poet Lord Byron.
